reuse.why: Reuses getNextDate and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but getUpcomingDates and the budget template each re-derive the daily-drops-weekend rule instead of getting it from one shared predicate or from getNextDate.

duplication.why: `skipWeekend && frequency === 'daily'` plus an isWeekend filter is written in getNextDate (twice, for the forward and reverse lookups), getUpcomingDates and schedule-template.ts.

placement.why: The core rule is put in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate where weekend solving already lives, but server/schedules/app.ts and server/budget/schedule-template.ts carry their own copies of the decision.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the weekend rule, the frequency plumbing in parseRecurDate, and tests.

maintainability.why: Three independently phrased versions of the same rule, with differing lookahead caps (7 attempts vs count*7+7), will drift the next time weekend handling changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and createScheduleList (server/budget/schedule-template.ts) decide weekend dropping themselves instead of going through getNextDate/getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: The same dropsWeekend predicate is re-expressed as `dropsWeekend`/`isDroppedWeekend` in the template, an inline early-return loop in getUpcomingDates, and a take-N-then-filter in getNextDate.

one_place.where: The daily-skip rule is defined separately in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList.
